predictions.claim: AGI-like systems will exist within the next decade.
predictions.speaker: Demis Hassabis
predictions.notes: Stated as 'wouldn't be surprised' — softer than median; track against scaling+planning hybrid systems.

predictions.claim: True multimodality will become the default user experience over the next year to 18 months, with contextual camera/voice/touch interaction replacing chat as the primary modality.
predictions.speaker: Demis Hassabis
predictions.notes: Tracks consumer adoption of multimodal assistants and glasses-class devices.

predictions.claim: Within 3–5 years, frontier labs will need air-gapped data centers and specialized secure hardware to protect model weights.
predictions.speaker: Demis Hassabis
predictions.notes: Watch for public disclosures of air-gapped training infra at OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind.

predictions.claim: AI systems will become the world's best research assistants for scientists and clinicians once factuality and grounding are fixed.
predictions.speaker: Demis Hassabis
predictions.notes: No hard date given; revisit in three years to check if hallucination/grounding has been substantially solved.

predictions.claim: AGI, once it arrives, will help design and build the next versions of itself, potentially accelerating AI R&D significantly.
predictions.speaker: Demis Hassabis
predictions.notes: Hassabis frames this as possible, not imminent; track measurable AI-R&D-from-AI contributions.
